## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 已在 Windows 上实测，并在上方记录结果；或已说明不适用的原因。 / Tested on Windows and recorded the results above, or documented why this is not applicable.
- [ ] 已更新 CHANGELOG.md；或已在上方说明无需更新的原因。 / Updated CHANGELOG.md, or explained above why an update is not needed.
- [ ] 已更新受影响的文档。 / Updated affected documentation.
- [ ] 已检查提交内容，未包含密钥、私人数据或本机构建产物。 / Checked that the changes contain no secrets, private data, or local build artifacts.
